tests.title: A member of the workspace's org gets 200 on every per-run read route and the transcript
given: org O holds U1 (owner) and U2 (member); workspace W is owned by U1 in O and is active
run R has events, session outcomes, tool calls, tool errors, traces, a postmortem and a transcript node
U2 holds a PAT with audit:read
tests.when: U2 sends GET to /workspaces/W/runs/R/{events,sessions/outcomes,tools/calls,tools/errors,traces,postmortem} and /transcript?node_id=N
then: every response status is 200
each body carries the same shape and rows the owner U1 receives for the same route
tests.pseudocode: seedOrg(O,[U1,U2]); seedWorkspace(W,U1,org=O); for route in routes: r=get(route, patAuth(U2,'audit:read')); assert r.status==200; assert r.json==get(route, patAuth(U1,'audit:read')).json

tests.title: Owner and admin token keep reading per-run routes and the access decision goes binding check then NeedRead
given: workspace W owned by U1; admin token available
tests.when: U1 and an admin token each call every per-run read route for W
then: every answer is 200
the owner's body equals the admin's body
tests.pseudocode: for route in routes: assert get(route, owner).status==200; assert get(route, admin).status==200

tests.title: A member can read the per-run routes of an archived workspace
given: U2 is a member of org O; workspace W in O has status archived and holds run data
tests.when: U2 requests each per-run read route and the transcript for W
then: every answer is 200, not 404 and not 403
tests.pseudocode: seedWorkspaceWithStatus(W,U1,'archived',org=O); for route in routes: assert get(route,U2).status==200

tests.title: A caller without audit:read is refused with the scope message before any workspace lookup
given: U2 is a member of W's org with a PAT lacking audit:read
the request names a workspace slug that does not exist
tests.when: U2 requests a per-run read route
then: the status is 403
the error is today's audit:read scope message, not 'workspace not found'
tests.pseudocode: r=get('/workspaces/nope/runs/R/events', patAuth(U2,'sessions:read')); assert r.status==403; assert errOf(r)==scopeMsg('audit:read')

tests.title: A stranger or an unknown workspace gets 404 workspace not found on all per-run routes and no audit rows are queried
given: workspace W in org O with run data; U3 is neither owner nor member nor admin; slug 'missing' does not exist
tests.when: U3 requests every per-run read route and the transcript for W, and for 'missing'
then: every status is 404
every body error is 'workspace not found'
no audit data appears in the body
tests.pseudocode: for slug in [W,'missing']: for route in routes: r=get(route, patAuth(U3,'audit:read')); assert r.status==404; assert errOf(r)=='workspace not found'

tests.title: Per-run validations still apply to a member after the access check
given: U2 is a member of W's org; W has no postmortem for run R2
tests.when: U2 sends a malformed run_id, a transcript request without node_id, and a postmortem request for R2
then: malformed run_id answers the same 400 as the owner
missing node_id answers 400 'node_id is required'
postmortem answers 404 with error postmortem_not_found
tests.pseudocode: assert get(badRunIdRoute,U2).status==400; assert get(transcriptNoNode,U2).status==400 and 'node_id is required' in err; assert errType(get(postmortemR2,U2))=='postmortem_not_found'

tests.title: With a nil SQLite handle the per-run routes skip the workspace check for every caller
given: audit routes are registered with a nil SQLite handle
tests.when: a PAT caller with audit:read requests a per-run read route for any slug
then: the workspace check does not refuse; the status is the handler's normal non-access status, not 404 workspace not found
no panic occurs
tests.pseudocode: env=newAuditTestEnv(nilSQLite); r=get(eventsRoute, patAuth(U9,'audit:read')); assert r.status==200

tests.title: A member reads session, usage, cost and the workspace session list of an active workspace
given: W is active in org O owned by U1; session S belongs to W with usage rows; U2 is a member with sessions:read
tests.when: U2 calls GET /sessions/S, GET /sessions/S/usage, GET /workspaces/W/cost and GET /sessions?workspace_slug=W
then: each answers 200
the bodies carry S, its usage, W's cost summary and a list containing S
tests.pseudocode: for p in [sessions/S, sessions/S/usage, workspaces/W/cost, sessions?workspace_slug=W]: assert get(p,U2).status==200

tests.title: Session read routes refuse non-active, unreadable, missing and out-of-binding workspaces with 403 workspace access denied
given: session S1 in archived W_a (member U2), S2 in W_s of a stranger, a missing workspace slug, and a PAT of U2 bound to another workspace
tests.when: U2 reads S1, S2, cost of the missing slug, and the bound PAT reads a session of W
then: every answer is 403 with error 'workspace access denied'
tests.pseudocode: for req in cases: r=get(req); assert r.status==403; assert errOf(r)=='workspace access denied'

tests.title: A missing session id answers 404 session not found before the workspace check
given: any caller with sessions:read, including a stranger
tests.when: GET /sessions/nope and GET /sessions/nope/usage
then: both answer 404 with error 'session not found'
tests.pseudocode: for p in ['sessions/nope','sessions/nope/usage']: r=get(p,stranger); assert r.status==404; assert errOf(r)=='session not found'

tests.title: A caller without sessions:read is refused with the scope message before any lookup
given: member U2 with a PAT lacking sessions:read
tests.when: U2 calls the four session read routes
then: each answers 403 with the unchanged sessions:read scope message
tests.pseudocode: for p in sessionReadRoutes: r=get(p, patAuth(U2,'audit:read')); assert r.status==403; assert errOf(r)==scopeMsg('sessions:read')

tests.title: With a nil SQLite handle get and usage skip the check and cost refuses non-admins
given: session routes registered with a nil SQLite handle; one session stored
tests.when: a non-admin calls GET /sessions/:id, GET /sessions/:id/usage and GET /workspaces/W/cost
then: get and usage answer 200
cost answers 403 with error 'workspace access denied'
tests.pseudocode: assert get(sess,pat).status==200; assert get(usage,pat).status==200; r=get(cost,pat); assert r.status==403 and errOf(r)=='workspace access denied'

tests.title: The session list without a slug includes owned and member active workspaces' sessions
given: U2 owns W_own and is a member in W_team (both active); a stranger's workspace W_x has a session
tests.when: U2 calls GET /sessions with no workspace_slug
then: status 200
sessions of W_own and W_team are listed
sessions of W_x are not listed
filters, order and cursor behave as before
tests.pseudocode: r=get('/sessions',U2); assert slugs(r)=={'W_own','W_team'}

tests.title: A caller with no readable active workspace gets an empty list, not an unrestricted one
given: sessions exist in other users' workspaces; the caller has no workspace and no membership
tests.when: the caller calls GET /sessions; and getAccessibleWorkspaces is called for the caller
then: status 200 with an empty sessions list
the restriction list is non-nil and empty
tests.pseudocode: r=get('/sessions',lonely); assert r.status==200 and len(r.sessions)==0; l,_=getAccessibleWorkspaces(db,lonely); assert l!=nil and len(l)==0

tests.title: A bound PAT lists at most its bound workspace's sessions and no refusal report is made
given: U2 is a member of W's org (W active) and owns W2; U2's PAT is bound to W; sessions exist in both; an observer counts refusal reports
tests.when: the bound PAT calls GET /sessions with no slug
then: status 200 with only W's sessions
the observer was called 0 times
when the user may not read W (membership removed) the list is empty
tests.pseudocode: r=get('/sessions',boundPatAuth(U2,tok)); assert slugs(r)=={'W'}; assert reports==0

tests.title: An admin token lists sessions of every workspace
given: sessions in three workspaces of different owners
tests.when: an admin token calls GET /sessions
then: status 200 and all three workspaces' sessions are returned
tests.pseudocode: r=get('/sessions',adminAuth()); assert slugs(r)==all

tests.title: The session list never shows a session outside the caller's active readable workspaces
given: a fixture with random workspaces (active/archived, org_id null or set), random memberships, random sessions
tests.when: for any non-admin caller and any seeded workspaces, memberships and sessions, the caller lists GET /sessions
then: every returned session's workspace is active
and is owned by the caller or in an org the caller belongs to
every such session is returned (when within page size)
tests.pseudocode: for seed in gen(): r=get('/sessions',caller); for s in r.sessions: assert active(s.ws) and readable(caller,s.ws)

tests.title: GET /audit for a member lists events of owned and member workspaces of any status
given: U2 owns W_own, is a member of W_team and W_arch (archived); events exist in all three and in a stranger's W_x
tests.when: U2 calls GET /audit
then: status 200
events of W_own, W_team and W_arch are listed
no event of W_x
tests.pseudocode: r=get('/audit',U2); assert workspaces(r)=={'W_own','W_team','W_arch'}

tests.title: Hub events with an empty workspace are never returned to a non-admin on GET /audit
given: a hub event with workspace '' and events in U2's workspaces
tests.when: owner U1 and member U2 call GET /audit
then: neither response contains the empty-workspace event
tests.pseudocode: for u in [U1,U2]: assert all(e.workspace!='' for e in get('/audit',u).events)

tests.title: A workspace filter outside the readable set answers 404 and a binding refusal is reported once
given: U2 is not a member of W_x; a PAT of U2 bound to W_team; an observer counts reports
tests.when: U2 calls GET /audit?workspace=W_x; the bound PAT calls GET /audit?workspace=W_other
then: both answer 404 with error 'workspace not found'
the unbound call produces no report
the bound call produces exactly one report with Method GET, Route /api/v1/audit, Status 404
tests.pseudocode: r=get('/audit?workspace=W_x',U2); assert 404 and errOf=='workspace not found'; get('/audit?workspace=W_other',bound); assert reports==1

tests.title: An admin token's GET /audit is unrestricted and includes empty-workspace hub events
given: hub event with workspace '' and events in several workspaces
tests.when: an admin token calls GET /audit
then: status 200
the response includes the empty-workspace event and events of all workspaces
tests.pseudocode: r=get('/audit',adminAuth()); assert '' in workspaces(r) and len(workspaces(r))>=3

tests.title: GET /audit only returns events with a non-empty workspace in the caller's readable set
given: a fixture with random workspaces, memberships and events including empty-workspace hub events
tests.when: for any non-admin caller and any seeded events, the caller calls GET /audit
then: every returned event has a non-empty workspace
and that workspace is owned by or org-shared with the caller
tests.pseudocode: for seed in gen(): for e in get('/audit',caller).events: assert e.workspace!='' and readable(caller,e.workspace)

tests.title: A member's SSE stream delivers events of owned and member workspaces only
given: U2 owns W_own and is a member of W_team; stranger workspace W_x; a real SSE manager
tests.when: U2 opens GET /events and events are published for W_own, W_team and W_x
then: events of W_own and W_team arrive on the stream
the event of W_x does not arrive
tests.pseudocode: stream=open('/events',U2); publish(W_own); publish(W_team); publish(W_x); assert received(stream)=={W_own,W_team}

tests.title: The readable set of an open SSE connection is fixed at connect
given: U2 opens a stream as a member of W_team; then U2 is removed from W_team and added to W_new
tests.when: events are published for W_team and W_new
then: the W_team event is still delivered
the W_new event is not delivered
tests.pseudocode: stream=open(U2); removeMember(W_team,U2); addMember(W_new,U2); publish both; assert received(stream)=={W_team}

tests.title: GET /events with a workspace filter outside the readable set answers 404 with no stream header
given: U2 is not a member of W_x; a recording SSE manager
tests.when: U2 calls GET /events?workspace=W_x
then: status 404 with error 'workspace not found'
Content-Type is not text/event-stream
no connection was registered
tests.pseudocode: r=get('/events?workspace=W_x',U2); assert r.status==404; assert r.header['Content-Type']!='text/event-stream'; assert mgr.registered==0

tests.title: Events with an empty workspace reach only admin-token streams
given: an owner stream, a member stream and an admin stream are open
tests.when: a hub event with an empty workspace is published
then: only the admin stream receives it
tests.pseudocode: publish(Event{Workspace:''}); assert received(admin)==1; assert received(owner)==0 and received(member)==0

tests.title: The owner and an admin token can open a session, regardless of workspace status
given: W owned by U1 (active) and W_arch owned by U1 (archived)
tests.when: U1 posts a new session id for W, and an admin token posts one for W_arch
then: both answer 201 with the created session
session rows were written
tests.pseudocode: assert post('/sessions',{id:'a',workspace_slug:'W'},U1).status==201; assert post('/sessions',{id:'b',workspace_slug:'W_arch'},admin).status==201

tests.title: A member opening a session gets 403 forbidden and no row is written
given: U2 is a member of W's org with sessions:write; session count recorded
tests.when: U2 posts POST /sessions with workspace_slug W
then: status 403
error 'org members have read-only access to this workspace' with error_type 'forbidden'
session row count is unchanged
tests.pseudocode: n=count(sessions); r=post('/sessions',body,U2); assert r.status==403 and r.json.error_type=='forbidden'; assert count(sessions)==n

tests.title: A stranger or unknown slug opening a session gets 404 and no row is written
given: stranger U3 with sessions:write; slug 'missing' does not exist
tests.when: U3 posts POST /sessions for W and for 'missing'
then: both answer 404 with error 'workspace not found'
session row count unchanged
tests.pseudocode: for slug in [W,'missing']: r=post('/sessions',{workspace_slug:slug},U3); assert r.status==404 and errOf(r)=='workspace not found'

tests.title: Replaying an existing session id of another readable workspace returns the session with 200
given: U1 owns W1 and W2; session S exists in W2; U1 posts for W1 with S's id
a second case: an admin token replays
tests.when: POST /sessions with id S and workspace_slug W1
then: status 200 with the existing session record of W2
no new row written
tests.pseudocode: r=post('/sessions',{id:'S',workspace_slug:'W1'},U1); assert r.status==200; assert r.json.workspace_slug=='W2'

tests.title: Replaying an id whose session lives in an unreadable workspace answers 404 without disclosure
given: session S exists in stranger's W2; caller U1 owns W1
tests.when: U1 posts id S with workspace_slug W1
then: status 404 with error 'workspace not found'
the body does not contain S's data
tests.pseudocode: r=post('/sessions',{id:'S',workspace_slug:'W1'},U1); assert r.status==404 and errOf(r)=='workspace not found'

tests.title: A member completing or reporting usage on the owner's session gets 403 not session owner
given: session S opened by U1 in W; U2 is a member with sessions:write; rows snapshotted
tests.when: U2 posts /sessions/S/complete and /sessions/S/usage
then: both answer 403 with error 'not session owner'
session and usage rows are unchanged
tests.pseudocode: for p in ['complete','usage']: r=post('/sessions/S/'+p,body,U2); assert r.status==403 and errOf(r)=='not session owner'; assert snapshot()==before

tests.title: A member is refused on every ingestion route of an active workspace with workspace_access_denied
given: U2 is a member of active W with audit:write; row counts recorded
tests.when: U2 posts to each of the eight ingestion routes of W
then: each answers 403 with error_type 'workspace_access_denied'
audit row counts are unchanged
tests.pseudocode: for route in ingestionRoutes: r=post(route,validBody,U2); assert r.status==403 and r.json.error_type=='workspace_access_denied'; assert counts()==before

tests.title: Ingestion keeps checkWorkspaceAccess's order for every caller kind including members
given: workspaces that are missing, archived or active; callers who are owner, member, stranger, admin, bound elsewhere
tests.when: for any combination of workspace state and caller kind, an ingestion route is posted
then: the answer follows the order: missing 404, binding 404, archived 409 workspace_archived, non-owner 403 workspace_access_denied
a member on an archived workspace gets 409 workspace_archived
tests.pseudocode: for (state,caller) in product(): assert post(route,caller).status==expectedLadder(state,caller)

tests.title: A bound PAT of a member reads its bound workspace on per-run, session and audit routes
given: U2 is a member of W's org; U2's PAT is bound to W; W has run data, a session and events
tests.when: the bound PAT calls a per-run route, GET /sessions/:id and GET /audit?workspace=W
then: all answer 200
tests.pseudocode: t=boundPatAuth(U2,tok,'audit:read','sessions:read'); assert get(eventsRoute,t).status==200; assert get(sessions/S,t).status==200; assert get('/audit?workspace=W',t).status==200

tests.title: A bound PAT naming another workspace gets the route's usual refusal
given: PAT bound to W; U2 can read W2 as a member or owner
tests.when: the bound PAT requests per-run reads, the transcript, POST /sessions and GET /audit?workspace=W2, and session read routes for W2
then: per-run reads, transcript, POST /sessions and the audit filter answer 404 'workspace not found'
session read routes answer 403 'workspace access denied'
tests.pseudocode: for r in [runs,transcript,postSessions,auditFilter]: assert 404; for r in sessionReads: assert 403

tests.title: Each binding refusal produces exactly one report with method, route template and status
given: PAT bound to W; an observer records reports; target slug may exist-and-readable, exist-unreadable or missing
tests.when: the bound PAT makes one refused request on each route kind for each target slug kind
then: each refused request produces exactly one report {TokenID, UserID, BoundSlug, RequestedSlug, Method, Route, Status, Surface:'api'}
Route is the template, e.g. /api/v1/sessions/:id
Status is 404 on run reads, POST /sessions and /audit, 403 on session reads, cost
tests.pseudocode: for route,slugKind in product(): reset(); do(); assert len(reports)==1; assert reports[0]=={...,Route:template,Status:expected,Surface:'api'}

tests.title: Bound PAT list, audit and stream requests inside its binding produce no refusal report
given: PAT bound to W; observer counting reports
tests.when: the PAT calls GET /sessions, GET /audit and opens GET /events without a foreign workspace filter
then: responses are 200 and the observer was called 0 times
tests.pseudocode: get('/sessions',t); get('/audit',t); open('/events',t); assert reports==0

tests.title: A database failure while deciding access on per-run reads, transcript and POST /sessions answers 500
given: the org_members table is dropped (and in another case the binding table) so the membership/binding read fails; U2 not the owner; session count recorded
tests.when: U2 calls a per-run read route, the transcript and POST /sessions
then: each answers 500 with error 'internal server error'
no audit data is returned
no session row is written
tests.pseudocode: exec('DROP TABLE org_members'); for req in [run,transcript,postSessions]: r=do(req,U2); assert r.status==500 and errOf(r)=='internal server error'

tests.title: A database failure on session reads fails closed with 403 and the list returns nothing
given: membership read fails (org_members dropped); sessions exist
tests.when: U2 calls GET /sessions/:id, /usage, /cost, GET /sessions?workspace_slug=W and GET /sessions
then: single-workspace reads answer 403 'workspace access denied'
GET /sessions returns no session
tests.pseudocode: for p in sessionReads: assert get(p,U2).status==403; assert len(get('/sessions',U2).sessions)==0

tests.title: A ReadableSlugs or binding failure on GET /audit answers 500
given: the readable-set query fails (org_members dropped; and a bound PAT whose binding table is dropped)
tests.when: a non-admin calls GET /audit
then: status 500 with error 'internal server error'
no events in the body
tests.pseudocode: exec('DROP TABLE org_members'); r=get('/audit',U2); assert r.status==500 and errOf(r)=='internal server error'

tests.title: A ReadableSlugs or binding failure on GET /events answers 500 before any stream header
given: the readable-set query fails; a recording SSE manager
tests.when: a non-admin calls GET /events
then: status 500 with error 'internal server error'
no text/event-stream header
no connection registered
tests.pseudocode: r=get('/events',U2); assert r.status==500; assert r.header['Content-Type']!='text/event-stream'; assert mgr.registered==0

tests.title: A stranger gets exactly today's refusal on every route of this spec
given: random workspaces in orgs where the caller has no relation
tests.when: for any stranger to workspace W and any route of this spec, the stranger calls it
then: per-run reads, transcript, POST /sessions and the audit workspace filter answer 404 'workspace not found'
session read routes answer 403 'workspace access denied'
ingestion answers 403 workspace_access_denied
tests.pseudocode: for (route,seed) in gen(): r=call(route,stranger); assert (r.status,errOf(r))==today[route]

tests.title: Personal-org and NULL-org workspaces answer as before this spec
given: workspaces whose org's only member is the owner, or with NULL org_id; owners, strangers and admin
tests.when: for any such workspace and any request on a route of this spec
then: status and body equal the pre-spec answer for that caller (owner allowed, stranger refused as before)
tests.pseudocode: for ws in gen(personalOrNullOrg): for req in routes: assert call(req)==legacyExpected(req)

tests.title: No owner_id read decision remains in internal/audit outside checkWorkspaceAccess
given: the non-test Go sources of internal/audit
tests.when: the sources are parsed and scanned
then: no function named ownedWorkspaces is declared
owner_id queries appear only inside checkWorkspaceAccess
requireWorkspaceRead, hasWorkspaceAccess, readableWorkspaces and getAccessibleWorkspaces reference wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace or wsaccess.ReadableSlugs
tests.pseudocode: files=parse('internal/audit/*.go' minus _test); assert no FuncDecl 'ownedWorkspaces'; for q in ownerIdQueries(files): assert enclosingFunc(q)=='checkWorkspaceAccess'

tests.title: The shared SQLite fixture has org_id, clone_status and org_members
given: openTestSQLiteDB is called
tests.when: the workspaces columns and the org_members table are inspected, and a member row is inserted
then: workspaces has org_id and clone_status columns
org_members(org_id, user_id) exists and accepts a row
tests.pseudocode: db=openTestSQLiteDB(t); assert hasColumn(db,'workspaces','org_id') and hasColumn(db,'workspaces','clone_status'); exec('INSERT INTO org_members(org_id,user_id) VALUES(?,?)')

tests.title: A member reads a teammate's run audit, sessions and cost end to end
given: a real hub audit server on a real SQLite database with wsaccess
U1 owns active W in org O, U2 is a member; W has run R data, a session and usage
tests.when: U2 requests the run events, GET /sessions?workspace_slug=W and GET /workspaces/W/cost
then: run events answer 200 with R's events
session list answers 200 with W's sessions
cost answers 200 with W's cost summary

tests.title: A member sees the workspace in the unified query and the live stream
given: a real audit server with a real SSE manager and SQLite; U2 member of W's org; a hub event with empty workspace stored
tests.when: U2 calls GET /audit, opens GET /events, and an event for W is then published
then: GET /audit lists W's and U2's own events and no empty-workspace event
the stream delivers the W event to U2's connection

tests.title: A member's attempts to open or complete sessions are refused and change nothing
given: a real audit server on real SQLite; U1 owns W and session S; U2 is a member
tests.when: U2 posts POST /sessions for W and POST /sessions/S/complete
then: POST /sessions answers 403 with error_type forbidden
complete answers 403 'not session owner'
session rows are unchanged and S is not completed
